prompt: Two seasons after Demar Derozan was traded to the San Antonio Spurs, who was the leading scorer for the fifth place team in the Western Conference?
answer: Two seasons after DeMar DeRozan’s 2018 trade to San Antonio was the **2020–21 season**. The fifth-place Western Conference team was the **Dallas Mavericks**, whose leading scorer was **Luka Dončić**, averaging **27.7 points per game**.
